scope: Saved-data precision planning plus a disposable eight-worker measurement benchmark. No new founders, scientific futures, fits or automatic scientific launch.
exposure: All108 selected acquisition blocks, all864 five-model forecasts and all3456 saved outcomes are exposed development data. Earlier study verdicts and failed resource gates remain unchanged.
scientific_question: Does the fixed32-pair successor predictor forecast terminal reconstruction better than each of two fixed64-read direct predictors under matched and independent cue noise?

analysis.primary: Four new equal-read contrasts, each rival Brier minus successor32. Complete-cohort intersection-union claim requires every one-sided.025 block-t lower limit strictly above zero. A component with upper<=0 counts against the proposed advantage; otherwise unresolved. Individual95% intervals are not simultaneous95% intervals.
analysis.secondary: Direct8 andTT008 remain mandatory in every score and cost table, with fixed-reference contrasts and descriptive intervals. The original prospective three-model qualification is preserved separately. No fresh all-eight claim follows from passing the four primary tests. Also calculate all-eight planning requirements transparently.
analysis.endpoint: From the g14 packet:18 exact rewrites g15..32, then a fresh g33 native test. Every task-aligned final32-frame port mean strictly>.25. Earlier failure does not stop continuation.
analysis.weights: Equal acquisition block, equal current-expression class, equal selected packet within class, equal individual squared loss over every declared future replicate.
analysis.domain: New founder blocks from the same task/history generator, with boundary-only selection of up to2 pass and2 fail packets per eligible block. Fixed reader, writer, injury24 non-port cells, and both original cue-noise regimes. This is not yet reader/injury distribution-shift testing.
analysis.claim_boundary: Fresh conditional forecast superiority at equal native-read budgets would be useful forecasting evidence. It would not uniquely establish RDT, endogenous maintenance or a repair-benefit scheduler.

planning.variance: For108 blocks x4 saved future replicates, within=mean within-block sample variance and between_raw=sample variance of block means-within/4. Retain raw values and project variance=max(0,between_raw)+within/R. Replicates do not become independent founders.
planning.joint_rule: For each primary contrast use both Phi(sqrt(B)*(gain-margin)/sd-t(.975,B-1)) and noncentral-t survival at the same cutoff/noncentrality. Each method uses max(0,1-sum(1-marginal_power)), valid for arbitrary dependence. Require both conditional bounds>=.80. No multiplication of component powers.
planning.selection: For each R choose its smallest grid B satisfying the joint rule, then choose the feasible design with the shortest conservative full-cap runtime. Ties: fewer primary reads, fewer repeats, fewer blocks. Attempts fixed to the next full8-worker wave at or above2B. Preserve the complete grid and all infeasible designs.
planning.leave_one_block_out: All108 omissions, all R options, same primary rule. Diagnostic only; no favorable omission or repeat selection.
planning.independent_checks: Scalar linear Brier identity for all packet/replicate contrasts; scalar variance components and covariance; noncentral-t survival independently integrated over a chi-square mixture at selected and preceding counts; explicit wave enumeration and scalar binomial recursion.
planning.limits: Development-selected model/domain, effect-size uncertainty, projected repeat variance and non-Gaussian block gains limit power predictions. The SD inflation is a sensitivity, not an exact confidence bound for the variance-component model.

benchmark.measurement: Per packet/regime, run the qualified successor32 measurement and qualified direct64 measurement sequentially. Reuse writer32 and direct32 for pooled32, direct8 prefix for direct8, boundary only forTT008.128 primary native reads and4 separate flat audit reads. No optimized arithmetic or new scientific endpoint.
benchmark.order: Successor then direct for even fixture+regime index; reverse for odd. Retain every timing, including slower cases and process startup.

runtime.phase_maxima: Retain the slowest qualified historical acquisition/future unit across prior8-worker qualification and complete fresh study. New measurement uses slowest complete128-read unit and whole eight-worker benchmark wave. Do not replace a slower historical observation with a favorable newer one.
runtime.wave_formula: 1.5*(ceil(A/8)*acquisition_max + ceil(8*B/8)*joint_measurement_case_max + ceil(B*R/8)*future_block_repeat_max)+120. Up to4 packets x2 regimes per block. Future tasks span all B*R units; do not charge ceil(B/8)*R incorrectly.
runtime.eligibility: Price all-eligible,75% and50% scenarios beside the fixed2B attempt cap. Report binomial completion scenarios at p=.5,.6,.7,.75,.9,1 as illustrative iid assumptions, alongside the112/112 already observed eligible attempts. No claim that eligibility is guaranteed.

prospective_handoff.selection: First B eligible acquisition IDs in ascending completed8-block waves; retain rejected and surplus attempts. Freeze attempt cap before acquisition. No selection by forecasts or futures.
prospective_handoff.barrier: All five forecast probabilities and their full-cohort evidence must be sealed and independently checked before any fresh scientific continuation.
prospective_handoff.full_scope_gate: No partial-cohort inference, refitting, recalibration, model/control selection, adaptive horizon or outcome-dependent stop. Complete runner qualification and fresh CPU admission remain prerequisites to a scientific launch.

references.title: SciPy noncentral-t definition
references.use: Numerical distribution and independent normal/chi-square mixture audit; not evidence for empirical effect-size assumptions.
